title: Black Pine Circle School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. February 7-11, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Black Pine Circle School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & 9/11 Pentagon Memorial

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial
  • heck-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (four nights)

Day 2: Supreme Court Building & Evening Memorial Visits

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the International Spy Museum
  • Visit the United States Botanic Garden
  • Lunch
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit
  • Public Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building 
  • Meet and Greet with your Representatives- Pending Availability
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: Arlington National Cemetery & National Archives Museum

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the People’s House
  • Visit the National Archives Museum
  • Visit Ford’s Theater, Petersen House, and Aftermath Exhibits
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of the American Indian 
  • Dinner Allocation 
  • Watch a Performance at the Center for Performing Arts 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 5: George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate 
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Black Pine Circle School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From powerful memorials to hidden spy secrets, this Washington, D.C. experience is packed with history, culture, and one-of-a-kind moments your students will never forget! They'll explore the mysteries of the International Spy Museum, walk the hallowed grounds of Arlington National Cemetery, and discover incredible stories at the National Museum of African American History and Culture. Students will also tour the United States Capitol Building, visit the historic Ford's Theater, and reflect at the memorials along the National Mall. With so much to see and experience, this D.C. adventure is the perfect blend of education, excitement, and inspiration!
